name: Bistro district architecture
credit: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro; NVIDIA GameWorks RTXDI assets; mirror by Arseny Kapoulkine
adaptations: Selected exterior architecture only; original ancestor transforms baked, centered X/Z and ground normalized; positions/UV 16-bit, signed normal/tangent 16-bit; DDS converted and reduced in resolution; specular-glossiness shading retained through a local physical-material shader adapter. Glass uses opaque reflective panes to avoid transmission of the empty building shell.
